title: The page export and WAITING_COLLECTIONS include receipts
why: Owner ask, 13:20 CST Nov 7 ("why not fix it then"): the page export and WAITING_COLLECTIONS leave out the `receipts` collection, so receipts are lost from the record branch.
note: Done: a red test where an export of a page with a receipt drops it, then green; receipts appear under waiting/ on the next export. Built in #1443 (head 3274c89bf), with runner 8 to merge (coordinator, 14:11 CST Nov 7).
